NAV.CHILD_THERAPY_DESC: Specialized support for children and teens, helping them navigate emotional challenges.

NAV.COUPLES_THERAPY_DESC: Enhance understanding and affection between couples, helping to strengthen the relationship.

NAV.INDIVIDUAL_COUNSELING_DESC: Personal psychological support to help you overcome stress, anxiety, and regain confidence.

HERO.HEADING: Take The First Step Towards A Balanced & Fulfilling Life
HERO.DESCRIPTION: Our team of licensed psychologists and therapists is here to support you through life's challenges. We offer evidence-based therapy in a safe, confidential, and compassionate environment.

SERVICES_SECTION.HEADING: Comprehensive Therapy Services
SERVICES_SECTION.DESCRIPTION: We offer a wide range of therapeutic services to support your mental health journey at every stage of life.
SERVICES_SECTION.INDIVIDUAL_DESC: One-on-one therapy sessions tailored to your unique needs, helping you work through personal challenges and achieve emotional well-being.
SERVICES_SECTION.FAMILY_DESC: Strengthen family relationships, improve communication, and resolve conflicts with guidance from our experienced family therapists.
SERVICES_SECTION.COUPLES_DESC: Rebuild trust, deepen connection, and develop healthier communication patterns with your partner in a safe, neutral environment.
SERVICES_SECTION.GROUP_DESC: Find community and shared healing in facilitated group sessions that foster empathy, support, and personal growth.
SERVICES_SECTION.CHILD_DESC: Specialized support for children and teenagers navigating anxiety, behavioral challenges, academic stress, and developmental changes.
SERVICES_SECTION.TRAUMA_DESC: Compassionate, evidence-based trauma therapy to help you process difficult experiences and reclaim your sense of safety and self.

ABOUT_SECTION.HEADING: We Provide Professional, Dedicated, And Experienced Psychological Support
ABOUT_SECTION.PARA1: At Healingy, we believe that everyone deserves access to quality mental health care. Our team of licensed psychologists brings decades of combined experience across a full spectrum of therapeutic modalities.
ABOUT_SECTION.PARA2: We are committed to creating a warm, non-judgmental space where you can explore your thoughts and feelings at your own pace. Your healing journey is unique, and we walk it with you every step of the way.

BENEFITS_SECTION.HEADING: Why Choose Healingy?
BENEFITS_SECTION.DESCRIPTION: We combine professional expertise with genuine compassion to deliver therapy that makes a real, lasting difference in your life.
BENEFITS_SECTION.PSYCHOLOGISTS_DESC: Our team consists of certified therapists with 10+ years of experience helping clients achieve lasting mental wellness.
BENEFITS_SECTION.METHODS_DESC: We use evidence-based therapeutic approaches tailored to your specific needs, goals, and personal circumstances.
BENEFITS_SECTION.SUPPORT_DESC: Continuous support throughout your healing journey — we are here for you between sessions and whenever you need guidance.

TESTIMONIALS_SECTION.HEADING: What Our Clients Are Saying
TESTIMONIALS_SECTION.DESCRIPTION: Real stories from real people who have experienced the Healingy difference in their mental health journey.
TESTIMONIALS_SECTION.T1_QUOTE: Working with my therapist at Healingy has been truly life-changing. I came in feeling overwhelmed and lost, and over the course of a few months I have developed real tools to manage my anxiety. I feel more like myself than I have in years.
TESTIMONIALS_SECTION.T2_QUOTE: My husband and I were on the brink of separation when we started couples therapy here. The sessions gave us a safe space to really hear each other for the first time. We are stronger today because of this experience and couldn't be more grateful.
TESTIMONIALS_SECTION.T3_QUOTE: After struggling for years with childhood trauma, I finally found a therapist who made me feel seen and understood. The trauma counseling program at Healingy gave me my confidence back. I highly recommend this practice to anyone seeking real healing.

BLOG_SECTION.A1_EXCERPT: Discover how CBT techniques empower you to identify and reframe negative thought patterns, reducing anxiety in everyday situations.
BLOG_SECTION.A2_TITLE: Understanding the Connection Between Sleep and Mental Health
BLOG_SECTION.A2_EXCERPT: Explore the powerful two-way relationship between quality sleep and emotional resilience, and learn practical steps to improve both.
BLOG_SECTION.A3_TITLE: 5 Mindfulness Practices for Daily Stress Relief
BLOG_SECTION.A3_EXCERPT: Simple, evidence-backed mindfulness exercises you can integrate into your daily routine to reduce stress and improve overall well-being.
